text: Ko onon gomɗimɓe ! wata on lamndo Nulaaɗo mon on fii piiji ɗi alaa e haaju mon ka diina mon, tawa non si ɗin feññinanaama on mettay on ko ɗi saɗtiri kon. Si on lamndino fii majji fewndo Qur'aanaare nden Jippotoo e Nulaaɗo on, ɗi feññinante on, ɗum ko ko newanii Alla. Gomɗii Alla Yawtanii gaay e piiji ɗi Qur'aana deƴƴi fii mun, wata on lamndo fii majji, si tawii le on lamndike fii majji, O Jippinay e mon Ñaawooje majji.
